approaches.title: Recursive subsequence counting with memoization
approaches.summary: Recursively explores matching characters of s against t to count distinct subsequences. Memoization is added to reuse overlapping subproblems, but the revision remains marked wrong for performance reasons.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a naive recursive enumeration of matching subsequences, but it is marked wrong and includes debugging output. The recursion has incorrect handling of some starting states.

approaches.title: One-dimensional bottom-up dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Uses a one-dimensional DP array where dp[j] counts ways to form the first j characters of t while scanning s. Iterating target positions backward preserves the previous state for each character.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces recursive memoization with an iterative one-dimensional DP solution. It processes t backward for each character of s and uses i64 storage before returning the result as i32.
